title: netSoldier Detection Event
description: Canonical detection event produced by the detection-engine and consumed by the killswitch-controller. Version 2.x. Mirrors events.DetectionEvent in libs/events; libs/events/schema_test.go fails when the two drift apart. Receivers ignore unknown fields so minor versions can add optional ones; this schema describes the exact 2.0 shape.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. Receivers reject a major version they do not speak.

id.description: DET-<per-process prefix>-<counter>; unique across restarts. Composite detections get their own id.

summary.description: Human-readable description. The ONLY field meant for display; never used to decide or perform enforcement.

domain.description: The DNS name actually observed (the queried name), absent when the detection has none. Never rule text, an address, a fingerprint or a decorated string.

matched_ioc.description: Indicator of the strongest signal, for display and as the false-positive suppression key.

ioc_type.description: Type of matched_ioc. Open vocabulary: domain, ip, cidr, url, ja3, tlsfp, md5, sha256, sid, ...

client_ip.description: Canonical IPv4 or IPv6 address of the client that triggered the detection.

client_mac.description: Lower-case colon-separated MAC of the client device, when known.

client_name.description: Hostname or friendly name of the client device, when known.

severity.description: Derived from confidence: >=90 critical, >=70 high, >=50 medium, else low.

confidence.description: Combined confidence over all signals (noisy-OR for composites).

threat.description: Malware family or threat campaign name.

mitre_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. T1071, T1071.004).

query_type.description: DNS query type (A, AAAA, CNAME, etc.).

signal_class.description: The class of a single-signal event; 'composite' when signals span more than one distinct class.

signals.description: The evidence: one entry per contributing signal, each with its own confidence.

target.description: What enforcement may act on. Absent: nothing to enforce automatically.

class.description: ioc and ids-signature are known-bad; the rest are heuristics.

indicator.description: The concrete indicator this signal attests, canonical form.

indicator_type.description: Type of indicator. Open vocabulary, as ioc_type.

source.description: Feed or sensor that produced this signal.

value.description: Canonical value: a lower-case hostname, or a canonical IPv4/IPv6 address.
